meta.note: Curated historical events with the option-flow signatures they left behind. Used as retrieval context for LLM explanations. Numbers are stylized summaries of well-documented events, not proprietary data.

events.title: Black Monday

signature.iv_move: S&P index vol permanent regime shift; skew (OTM puts richer than OTM calls) becomes structural feature from this point on
signature.pc_flow: extreme put demand; index-put insurance mania in the aftermath

events.lesson: The event that created the equity 'volatility smile' as we know it. Before 1987 the surface was roughly flat; after, OTM puts always trade richer than OTM calls at the same delta.

events.title: Asian Currency Crisis

signature.iv_move: index IV +30 to 40 vol-points in a session
signature.pc_flow: put/call flow tilted heavily to puts on Asia ADRs and financials

events.lesson: Cross-asset correlations spike in a crisis — anomalies that fire in one name often propagate to peers within minutes.

events.title: LTCM Collapse

signature.iv_move: vol regime shifted 20+ points across index and single names
signature.pc_flow: put demand persistent for weeks post-event

events.lesson: 'Uncorrelated' strategies correlate to 1.0 during liquidations. A single-name IV spike near a big fund's known holdings often has a systemic cause.

events.title: Dot-com Peak

signature.iv_move: tech-name IV very high going in, collapsed as the bubble deflated over 2000-2002
signature.pc_flow: extreme call skew — retail bought upside; put IV lagged

events.lesson: Extreme call demand can precede tops. When call skew is richer than put skew for a full sector, ask why.

events.title: 9/11 Market Halt

signature.iv_move: on-reopen index IV +25 points overnight
signature.pc_flow: put demand overwhelming for airlines, insurance, and index

events.lesson: Exogenous shocks reopen with a gap and an IV surface that already re-priced in the void. Detector fires immediately at market open.

events.title: Global Financial Crisis / Lehman

signature.iv_move: VIX ran 20 to >80; single-name financial IV multiples higher
signature.pc_flow: sustained put demand for 6 months, put/call ratios pinned >1.5

events.lesson: The archetypal put/call regime shift. Once put/call ratios establish a new elevated baseline for weeks, the detector should widen its z-score windows or it'll normalize the crisis.

events.title: Flash Crash

signature.iv_move: intraday IV +30 points, mostly reversed by close
signature.pc_flow: put volume/OI ratios blew out on the way down

events.lesson: Microstructure events fire the detector but don't sustain — treat vol/OI spikes without persistent P/C follow-through as microstructure, not fundamentals.

events.title: US Downgrade / EU Debt

signature.iv_move: VIX 20 to 48
signature.pc_flow: put demand persistent on European names

events.lesson: Sovereign credit stress shows first in European bank IV before spreading to index.

events.title: SNB Removes Franc Peg

signature.iv_move: CHF vols exploded; equity effects minor
signature.pc_flow: FX-hedge-related demand in banks with CHF exposure

events.lesson: Central-bank surprises leave near-invisible spot moves in equities but visible put demand in banks with exposure — a case for cross-asset context.

events.title: Brexit Vote

signature.iv_move: GBP and FTSE IV peaked before vote, crushed after gap
signature.pc_flow: put demand pre-vote reversed to selling post-vote

events.lesson: Binary-event IV crushes hard on resolution — a fire on the way in and a mirror-image fire on the way out.

events.title: Volmageddon (XIV Blow-up)

signature.iv_move: VIX 17 to 50 in a session; short-vol ETPs blew up
signature.pc_flow: call demand in VIX products, put demand in equity

events.lesson: Crowded short-vol trades unwind non-linearly. IV spikes with a very specific microstructure signature (VIX complex first, equity second) point to derivatives-driven, not fundamental, events.

events.title: COVID Crash

signature.iv_move: VIX 14 to 82; skew steepened massively then normalized over weeks
signature.pc_flow: sustained put demand on index and travel/hospitality names

events.lesson: The exogenous-shock playbook: IV surface pops, skew steepens, put/call ratio inverts. First-week signals are the tightest; second-week signals get discounted as the new baseline sets in.

events.title: GameStop Short Squeeze

signature.iv_move: GME IV 100 to >800 vol-points across the whole surface
signature.pc_flow: P/C inverted — calls vastly outnumbered puts; OTM call flow dominated

events.lesson: The archetypal call-frenzy signature: P/C ratio well below 1, short-dated OTM calls carrying most of the volume, IV surface flattening as demand crushes skew.

events.title: Meme-Stock Cluster (AMC, BB, NOK)

signature.iv_move: similar pattern in AMC/BB/NOK; correlated call frenzy
signature.pc_flow: cross-name P/C inversions

events.lesson: Retail-driven squeezes cluster — a single-name signal often has a peer group firing in parallel.

events.title: 2022 Rate Shock

signature.iv_move: VIX oscillated 25-35 for months; skew stayed persistently steep
signature.pc_flow: steady put demand on growth names

events.lesson: Persistent regimes: when P/C stays elevated for weeks, the detector's window normalizes the new baseline. Look for *changes* in a stressed regime, not the level.

events.title: SVB Collapse

signature.iv_move: regional-bank IV +30 points; SVB itself halted; index IV modest
signature.pc_flow: put demand ripped across sector — KRE puts dominated

events.lesson: Sector-specific stress: fires in one name propagate to peers within an hour. Cross-asset correlation view is decisive.

events.title: Credit Suisse Bailout

signature.iv_move: CS IV extreme; systemic-financial IV modestly higher
signature.pc_flow: put demand persistent on European banks

events.lesson: A troubled name's IV can pop without materially dragging the index — single-name stress is not always systemic.

events.title: Yen Carry Unwind

signature.iv_move: VIX briefly touched 65 intraday; reversed same session
signature.pc_flow: concentrated put demand on tech, crash pattern on Nikkei

events.lesson: Cross-asset carry unwinds can produce single-session IV spikes with very fast reversion. Confidence should discount hard when the underlying signal reverts within hours.

events.title: Earnings IV Crush Pattern

signature.iv_move: IV builds pre-earnings, crushes ~30-50% overnight after release
signature.pc_flow: balanced pre; directional post based on beat/miss

events.lesson: Scheduled events are not anomalies — detector should suppress fires on names within 2 sessions of a known earnings date. (Not implemented in this synthetic demo but the pattern is here for reference.)

events.title: FOMC Day IV Pattern

signature.iv_move: index IV compresses into 2pm ET, then re-prices in one session
signature.pc_flow: put/call ratio can swing sharply based on Powell's tone

events.lesson: Scheduled macro events fire the detector predictably. In production this suggests a calendar-aware suppression layer.
